source.review_method: Rendered physical pages were visually inspected by a human. PDF text extraction was used only for navigation and token cross-checking; page layout determines source-block boundaries and graphical/contextual status.
source.page_mapping: physical page = printed page + 32 for this scope

scope.notes: Sections 7.25-7.27 were visually reviewed on every printed page 145-162, including code blocks that continue across page boundaries.

status_vocabulary.context_fragment: Textual notation shown as a compartment or shorthand that requires an enclosing owner/model context.
status_vocabulary.incomplete_placeholder: A reviewed source block retains a literal omission marker or placeholder ellipsis; omitted content is not invented.
status_vocabulary.diagram_note_code: Closed textual code printed in a diagram note; retained as source because the note itself contains a complete SysML block.
